prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a candid 1985 VHS camcorder still of an adult East Asian woman seated on a patterned bedspread in a lived-in bedroom, turning toward the handheld camera with a small object in her hands. She has loose dark hair and wears an oversized heather-gray T-shirt. At left, a large beige adjustable desk lamp glows warmly; behind her sit a CRT television showing blue static, a corded landline phone, shelves of VHS tapes, and soft window blinds. Use real mid-1980s consumer VHS characteristics: 3200K tungsten lamp warmth, NTSC color response, gentle tube bloom, interlacing, horizontal tracking noise, slight rightward chroma bleed, dense warm tape grain, and imperfect 4:3 framing. Render the orange camcorder timestamp AUG 8 1985 9:14PM in the lower-right corner.
